rules.title: An Act prohibiting algorithmic rent setting (S.2983)
rules.requirement: Proposed bill that would prohibit algorithmic rent setting in Massachusetts rental housing. As of the retrieval date it had been reported favorably by the Joint Committee on Housing and referred to Senate Ways and Means.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental housing in Massachusetts. The bill text is not reproduced in the document, so specific coverage terms are not stated.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Bill text not included in the document; coverage details unknown.
